title: pde-operator-experiment: a classical solver, a PINN, a DeepONet and an FNO on one elliptic PDE with an exact solution
description: A reproducible comparison of a finite-difference solver, a physics-informed neural network, a DeepONet and a Fourier neural operator on the one-dimensional elliptic equation -(a u')' = 1 with random coefficients, scored against an exact solution. It measures in-distribution accuracy, training-set size, distribution shift, resolution transfer and cost, with the classical solver treated as a competitor on equal terms. Code, results and figures accompany Part 3 of a Medium series on scientific machine learning.
